title: The Holy Maiden Declares War with Overwhelming Dominance
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing closes in within three chi, demonic path forbidden arts already gathering at her fingertips. Chen Ji is forced to make a choice—accepting the wager may result in instant death, refusing means losing this opportunity. And that wisp of familiar scent, what does it truly signify?

text.content: Black radiance like an abyss, devouring the last thread of celestial light within the secret realm. Ye Qing stands upon the Void, demonic path pressure materializing as overwhelming force. The cultivation of Core Formation late stage transforms into an invisible mountain, compressing all air within a hundred zhang into viscous substance. The meaningful curve at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth hasn't yet faded, but he feels his shoulders suddenly heavy—this is pressure beyond realm, an insurmountable chasm between mortals and Core Formation.

Pfft—! A muffled sound comes from beside them. A Tianqing Sect disciple at Foundation Building late stage immediately vomits a mouthful of blood, his face pale as paper, knees turning weak as he falls to the ground. Following are several more miserable cries—those with slightly weaker cultivation all have blood flowing from their seven orifices, clutching their chests and collapsing. The demonic path Holy Maiden's pressure, having released merely a wisp, has caused nearly half of Chen Ji's group of more than ten people to lose their combat capability.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... right? A Servant Disciple from Tianqing Sect, a ant that crawled out of the garbage heap.

text.content: Ye Qing looks down from above, her jet-black eyes reflecting Chen Ji's unruffled face. Her tone carries a playful quality: "This Holy Maiden is very curious—how did a waste come to be here? Could there be... a behind-the-scenes expert guiding you?" The moment her voice falls, the black radiance at her fingertips suddenly surges. An even more terrifying pressure rushes toward Chen Ji like a tide.

dialogue.content: Does Her Highness the Holy Maiden feel it's beneath her dignity to make such a grand fuss against a waste?
Ye Qing! He is a Tianqing Sect disciple. Your demonic path Holy Sect's hand is reaching too far!

text.content: Su Qingyao positions herself in front of Chen Ji, her sword aura biting cold, yet even she is forced by that pressure to have her garments fluttering and her complexion slightly pale. Her hand trembles slightly, but she grips the sword hilt tightly, refusing to retreat even half a step. Ye Qing's gaze sweeps over her, the corner of her mouth hooking into a sneer: "Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect? Interesting. However..." She shifts her tone, "This Holy Maiden today has not come to kill. I'm here for the treasures within this secret realm."

dialogue.content: Very simple—a wager. You and I duel alone. The victor claims the secret realm's ultimate treasure. The loser... brings their people and gets out.

text.content: The moment the wager is proposed, silence descends upon the surroundings. Everyone exchanges glances, their eyes filled with disbelief—this is clearly a blatant death sentence! A Foundation Building initial stage waste fighting against a Core Formation late stage demonic path Holy Maiden? Even if Chen Ji had nine lives, they wouldn't be enough! Someone has already quietly retreated, afraid of being caught in the crossfire of this immensely uneven confrontation.

However, just at this moment, Chen Ji suddenly detects something unusual. Within the demonic path mist surrounding Ye Qing, there is actually a wisp of extremely faint scent that feels familiar—it is a kind of... blood pulse familiar enough to make his heart tremble, as if echoing from some distant memory. His pupils narrow slightly, his heart surging with mighty waves, yet his expression remains unmoved.

Su Qingyao abruptly turns her head, staring at Chen Ji intently, and whispers: "Chen Ji, have you gone mad? That's Core Formation late stage! You have absolutely no chance of victory!" Her voice carries a rare urgency. "Don't show off—we can find another way—" Before she finishes, the black radiance at Ye Qing's fingertips has already condensed into a phantom sword, pointing directly at Chen Ji's Brow Center.

dialogue.content: What? The waste doesn't dare accept the challenge? Then none of you shall leave this secret realm alive today.

text.content: Chen Ji lowers his gaze, his eyelashes trembling slightly. He is calculating rapidly—accept the wager, and the Core Formation late stage pressure could kill him on the spot; refuse and escalate the conflict, Ye Qing will never let it go, since she dares to act here, she must have backup plans; expose the opponent's weakness, but that wisp of familiar scent... he needs more time to confirm. Each of the three options has its drawbacks and advantages, and he has only three breaths to decide.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's demonic sword hangs above his head. Chen Ji must make a choice—endure and maneuver, retreat to advance, or risk probing the opponent's trump card?

choices.description: First agree to the wager to buy time, secretly look for flaws, use words to probe the opponent's true situation. So what if it's Core Formation late stage? Chen Ji never fights battles without certainty.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more strength, attracting more attention
choices.visible_reward: Gain breathing time, probe Ye Qing's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: Once seen through, will completely lose chance for a comeback

dialogue.content: A faint smile curves Chen Ji's lips as he steps forward. "Interesting. Since Her Highness the Holy Maiden wishes to play, Chen is... at your service. However, shouldn't the rules of this wager be clearly established?"

text.content: A flash of surprise crosses Ye Qing's eyes, as if she hadn't expected a waste to be so composed. But she quickly collects herself. "What rules do you wish to add?" Her tone was arrogant, yet she gave Chen Ji the opportunity to speak.

choices.description: Do not respond to provocation directly. Instead, throw out larger stakes or threats, using benefits to lure the opponent to temporarily hold back. Retreat to advance, seek outside help.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen through as bluffing
choices.visible_reward: Buy time for companions to retreat
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing doesn't buy it, will completely enrage the opponent

dialogue.content: Your Highness the Holy Maiden misunderstands. Chen never makes losing trades—the secret realm's ultimate treasure may be good, but it's not worth Chen trading his life for. As for Your Highness... aren't the troubles within the demonic path Holy Sect about the same as those in this secret realm?"

text.content: The moment these words are spoken, Ye Qing's gaze turns ice-cold and stern. The demonic energy around her churns. "Are you threatening me?" she says word by word, killing intent blazing. Su Qingyao takes the chance to pull Chen Ji back several steps, whispering: "You've gone mad!"

choices.description: Directly point out the meaning of that familiar scent on Ye Qing, probe her reaction. High risk, high reward—may open a completely new situation.
choices.visible_cost: Expose that you possess key information
choices.visible_reward: May shake Ye Qing's state of mind, obtain key clues
choices.risk_hint: If judgment is wrong, will become an eternal mortal enemy

dialogue.content: Your Highness the Holy Maiden's demonic arts... are very interesting. That wisp of bloodline scent, Chen seems to have seen it somewhere before. May I ask, Your Highness... have you ever heard of the Chen family?"

text.content: Ye Qing's body stiffens abruptly. A flash of nearly imperceptible panic crosses those jet-black eyes. Though merely an instant, Chen Ji caught it—he has won this gamble. At this moment, that long-sealed speculation in his heart grows ever clearer, and Ye Qing's secret seems more shocking than he imagined.

choices.memory_label: 夜清与陈家有未知联系

dialogue.content: What, waiting for something? This Holy Maiden's patience isn't that good.

text.content: Ye Qing's black radiance has already condensed into form. The terrifying aura of the demonic path forbidden arts begins to permeate the air. Chen Ji feels a suffocating tightness in his chest—that is the Tianji Record Fragment giving warning. Every prophecy tells him that accepting this confrontation bodes ill. However, just as he is about to speak, that familiar scent from Ye Qing washes over him again, like a call from the depths of his bloodline, nearly impossible to ignore. Su Qingyao's hand has already pressed against her sword hilt, ready to fight desperately at any moment. And those fallen Tianqing Sect disciples have only despair in their eyes—they shall likely all die in this secret realm today. At this moment, Chen Ji suddenly recalls Master Mo's words: "Those chosen by the Tianji Record never made it this far through strength alone." He takes a deep breath and makes his decision—

Chen Ji raises his head, staring directly into Ye Qing's eyes, jet-black like an abyss. His voice is unusually calm: "Chen accepts Your Highness the Holy Maiden's wager. However..." He shifts his tone, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth, "Chen has one condition—this confrontation is not today." Ye Qing raises an eyebrow: "You wish to delay?" Chen Ji shakes his head: "Three days later, the same location. Chen will give Your Highness a surprise." Ye Qing studies him for a long while, then suddenly laughs: "Interesting. This Holy Maiden will see exactly what tricks this waste can pull. The three-day deadline—you dare not escape—otherwise, this Holy Maiden will make the entire Tianqing Sect buried with you!" The black radiance收敛s. Ye Qing's figure vanishes into the depths of the secret realm, leaving only a scene of chaos and everyone's stunned expressions.
